_doc: Each gate names a skill that must be loaded in this session before a matching tool call runs. path_re matches Write/Edit/MultiEdit file paths (forward slashes); bash_re matches Bash commands; chart=true matches an Artifact publish whose file draws a chart. Optional for bash gates: cwd_re limits it to commands run in a matching folder; diff_re + diff_range limit it to when git diff --name-only <diff_range> lists a matching file. Add your own gates.

gates.why: PDF work uses the tested pdf-ops recipes
writing you publish goes through humanizer
